final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.constructorId AS id, c.nationality AS nat, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM s1) SELECT s1.id, s1.nat, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avgc AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avgc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
